correctness.rationale: The renewal identity F_q(k)=k^2∫e^{-ks}G_q(s)ds and sign-changing G_q′′ lead to a single Laplace critical point; the q↑1 comparison with h(k)=k/[(k+1)(k+2)] and q↓0 boundary-layer k=K/sqrt(q) give the stated limits. Direct inspection of RESULT.md and verify.py at the assigned tree confirms assumptions lambda,D>0 and 0<q<1; at q=1 uniqueness fails.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Strong prior result mathematically dominates the submitted claim or its central theorem. The published October 18 theorem uses the same Gaussian OU cycle, independent centered finite-width redraw, exact Poisson Jeffreys renewal reward, and proves unique optimal Poisson frequency at every width. Under a=(1-q)/q and dimensionless rate k=r/(2lambda), its a→infinity maximizer k~sqrt(a) and maximum a/2-sqrt(a)+o(sqrt(a) are exactly the later q↓0 formulas. The remaining q↑1 sqrt(2) limit follows directly by first-order expansion of the published exact f_a and its already-proved uniqueness, not an independent new finding.
